desc: Dr. Morepen Gluco One BG-03 Blood Glucose Test Strips are disposable electrochemical biosensor strips designed exclusively for use with the Dr. Morepen BG-03 Glucometer. The strips require only 0.5 µL of capillary whole blood and deliver accurate blood glucose results in approximately 5 seconds. The auto-code technology eliminates manual coding errors, making testing fast, simple, and reliable for home and professional use.
